test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The maximum and minimum total resistance that can be obtained by the combination of 5 coils of resistances 2Ω, 3Ω, 4 Ω, 6 Ω and 12 Ω will be __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**27Ω, 0.75 Ω**__

__**Solution:**__

Given the value resistance are **2Ω, 3Ω, 4 Ω, 6 Ω and 12 Ω.**

**Maximum resistance **is obtained when all the resistance are connected in **series.**

 
• Effective resistance in series connection are **RMₐₓ= R₁+R₂+R₃+R₄+R₅ **
 
• Maximum resistance is RMax= 2Ω+ 3Ω+ 4 Ω+ 6 Ω+12Ω=** 27Ω**

**​****Minimum resistance **is obtained when all the resistance are connected in **parallel.**

 
• Effective resistance in parallel connection are** 1/RMᵢₙ=1/R₁+1/R₂+1/R₃+1/R₄+1/R₅**
 
• Minimum resistance is**1/RMᵢₙ=1/2+1/3+1/4+1/6+1/12 = (6+4+3+2+1)/(12) = 16/12 = 4/3**
 
• therefore** RMin= 3/4 = 0.75Ω**
